slides.prompt: What do you spend money on every week?
slides.hint: Think about food, transport, or phone top-up.
slides.notes: 60-min Rabu lesson. Activate spending schema before Raju's email. Oral pair answers, 3 min. Bridge from 2 Sep describing people: today we help a person, not describe one.

slides.text: Hi, I hope you are doing well. I need some advice on how to manage my spending. Please share tips that help you control your expenses. You are good at handling money. Regards, Raju
slides.notes: Paraphrased Module p85 stimulus, kept short for projection. Expected: advice on managing spending. Teacher plays the NotebookLM primer video before or after this slide per SOT plan.

slides.feedback: Raju asks for advice, so your email must give tips.
slides.notes: P2 Part 1 content dimension: answer what the sender asked. Volunteers choose; teacher reveals. Non-digital fallback: fingers 1/2/3.

slides.prompt: What shape does good advice take?
slides.answer: Greeting, two or three tips with reasons, then closing.
slides.feedback: Each part has a job: hello, help, goodbye.
slides.notes: Model the Module suggested answer shape without copying its sentences. Elicit parts before revealing.

slides.answer: You should make a budget. Save a little money. Do not buy what you do not need.
slides.feedback: Should plus verb advises. Do not plus verb warns.
slides.notes: Core advice frames for the book task. Drill should + verb chorally. Misconception to listen for: should to buy / should not saving (wrong verb form).

slides.sentence: You {{blank}} buy things you do not need.
slides.feedback: Should not warns kindly. Should would push bad spending.
slides.notes: Click fills the blank inline; Reset clears it. Check polarity meaning, not just grammar.

slides.feedback: Because adds a reason. Reasons persuade readers.
slides.notes: Organisation dimension: connect tip to reason. Ask a volunteer to add a different because ending.

items: I hope this helps! Regards, Ana
slides.feedback: Greet first, give tips in the middle, close last.
slides.notes: Click sentences in sequence. Reveal restores canonical order. Names the dependency: greeting opens, closing ends.

slides.task: In about 60 words, write an email to Raju giving him spending advice. Use two tips with reasons.
slides.frame: Hi Raju, You should … because … . Also, … . I hope these tips help! Regards, …
slides.notes: Module p85 book task, individual, ~15 min. Frame hidden until Reveal; weaker pupils may keep it. Collect books for marks per SOT.

slides.prompt: Tell your partner one tip for Raju.
slides.notes: Exit evidence, 3 min oral. Listen for should + verb and one reason. Weak or missing reasons become Thursday's retrieval bridge.
